item.title: Audio EXP Podcast: #313 – Crazy hippy Santa time
item.description: Toho acquires Anime Limited, the definitive 13th Age arrives, and we discuss the economics of community over competition with BackerKit CEO Max Salzberg.

item.title: Closer to Shakespeare than a dating sim: The House in Fata Morgana
item.description: This is not a dating sim. The House in Fata Morgana is a dark, Shakespearean tragedy about obsessive love and redemption. Read our review of the overlooked indie gem that delivers one of the most powerful stories in gaming.

item.title: Review – GAS: Ghost Ape System
item.description: Is GAS the last RPG you will ever need? We review the Ghost Ape System to see if this universal d20 ruleset delivers on its pulp promises or simply gets lost in the crowd.

item.title: Titan Comics unveils massive Summer 2026 line-up featuring Conan and Blade Runner
item.description: Titan Comics has revealed its complete Summer 2026 schedule, including new Conan omnibuses and a return to the world of Blade Runner Black Lotus.

item.title: Competition: Dune – Bene Gesserit Tarot Deck and Guidebook
item.description: Win the Dune: Bene Gesserit Tarot Deck and Guidebook. This UK competition offers a chance to own the 78-card deck featuring art from the recent films. Closes Jan 6.

item.title: Kobold Press’s “Black Flag” RPG Tales of the Valiant headlines new bundle
item.description: Bundle of Holding has a new deal for Tales of the Valiant, the "Project Black Flag" 5E-compatible RPG from Kobold Press.

item.title: Watch all of Trigun Stampede for free on YouTube before Stargaze arrives
item.description: Crunchyroll is hosting a global Trigun Stampede watch party on YouTube starting 6th January 2026, featuring an interview with Yasuhiro Nightow ahead of the Trigun Stargaze premiere.

item.title: Posthuman Studios launches open playtest for weird fantasy RPG The Snarl
item.description: Posthuman Studios has released the first playtest packet for The Snarl. Explore the "Weald" in this new weird fantasy RPG from the creators of Eclipse Phase.

item.title: Review: Runeway TTRPG – Quickstart
item.description: Hit the road in the world of Weyrd. We review the Runeway Quickstart from Mana Project Studio. A diceless, rune-based TTRPG mixing 90s tech, magic, and Studio Ghibli vibes.

item.title: Our take on Chaosium’s updated store locator
item.description: Find your nearest friendly local gaming store using our hacked Mythos-themed store locator. We’ve wrapped Chaosium’s map in an "occult haze"—dare you break the seal to find hidden archives in Salem, Providence, and beyond?
